name: The Taster's Fever
pitch: Keep your body two-thirds poison because the fever makes you fast, then pour it all into someone, because no pill will ever clean you again.

new.name: Art costs in a life stat
new.effect: An art may name a cost_resource other than linh lực or health. Combat rules 13 and 14, Formulas E; Character Stats rule 7.

questions: Bitter Tithe undercuts Combat Open Question 21, which links art speed to spending. Is that a hole you want open, or should art speed skip arts paid this way?
Cinnabar and Amber both follow a pattern the catalogue may only imply: pair convergences are overcoming pairs. Is that a rule you want?
